mechanism: The effect of fitting a linear diagnostic head to mean noisy features rather than to the mean single-rollout binary cross entropy on the same cached noisy features.
original_study: The original confirmation remains 0/6. Reusing all three frozen order-task encoders is deliberate conditioning, not three new training replications. Original source, weights, data, metrics and results remain unchanged.

runtime.dependency_receipt: Exact requirements bytes are frozen; runtime retains installed METADATA/RECORD SHA256 and NumPy/Torch build details. CI must also retain its pip installation report. No wheel-bit or cross-hardware bitwise identity claim follows solely from a version.

budget.development_role: Descriptive diagnostics only; no early stopping, head selection, hyperparameter tuning or confirmation promotion.

input_distribution.label: Independent Bernoulli(1/2) per example, drawn first.
input_distribution.noise: After label, draw normal(0,0.12,size=(1,8,2)); take index0.
input_distribution.frozen_reference: Same distribution as first_passage_operator/tasks.py order branch; never call its old namespace or load original examples. Each encoder has its own registered fresh examples.

streams.encoding: UTF-8, no spaces or terminal newline; decimal integers without padding.
streams.seed: Full32-byte SHA256 digest interpreted as unsigned little-endian integer; decimal seed and full key/digest recorded.
streams.generator: numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)); original native forward uses pinned NumPy default_rng(seed), whose bit generator is PCG64.
streams.bootstrap_seed: Same SHA256/full256-bit/little-endian conversion, with the exact bootstrap_key only.
streams.constructor_randomness: Original RenewalNetwork constructor uses its local Torch generator seeded by the frozen encoder seed; every parameter is immediately overwritten and checked before forward. It is invoked twice per encoder; no constructor output is used as data or fit initialization.
streams.independence_claim: Named pseudorandom streams; no mathematical independence or common Brownian paths across encoders claimed.

extraction.forward: Use unmodified RenewalNetwork(kind=first_passage).forward with batch1, capture=True, torch.no_grad and all requires_grad False.
extraction.features: Final second-layer3-dimensional decaying count trace only, reconstructed from native captured counts with the same Torch float64 decay recurrence.
extraction.affine_verification: Every one of43008 cached trajectories must reproduce its original native affine score at rtol=atol=1e-12; no extra diagnostic encoder evaluations.
extraction.weights: Strict restore and byte-canonical comparison of all55 parameters; check unchanged after each split.
extraction.logs: Per-split manifest plus64-example NPZ shards include input,label,feature,native logit,event counts and affine error. Native event list length must equal count at each of16 layer-segments.
extraction.native_reference: Evaluate original native head on same fresh traces descriptively; no additional gate.

preprocessing.fit_scope: For each encoder, pool only its cached training examples and rollouts.
preprocessing.location: Per-feature mean of pooled training traces.
preprocessing.scale: max(per-feature population standard deviation of pooled training traces, 1e-8).

arms.name: mean_feature_head
arms.objective: mean_i BCE(y_i, w^T mean_r Z_ir + b) + (0.001/2)*||w||_2^2

arms.name: single_rollout_risk_head
arms.objective: mean_i mean_r BCE(y_i, w^T Z_ir + b) + (0.001/2)*||w||_2^2

optimizer.regularization: Same coefficient 0.001 on three standardized-feature weights; intercept unpenalized.
optimizer.stable_loss: logaddexp(0,score) - label*score; no prediction clipping changes to the target risk.
optimizer.numerical_acceptance: Final four coefficients, objective and analytic gradient finite; gradient infinity norm<=1e-6. Retain optimizer success/status independently. No cap change, restart or replacement fit.
optimizer.exception_policy: Each attempted fit is recorded, including exceptions/nonconvergence. Complete the six attempts if cache generation is valid. Finite heads can be evaluated even if the numeric acceptance fails; the scientific gate must then remain numerically incomplete.

phase_order: Verify published parent, exact freeze bytes, dependency versions and threads.
Generate training cache, fit each fixed pair, generate descriptive development cache; retain all three encoders.
Write six-head hash freeze before opening any confirmation identity.
Generate exactly the confirmation budget; evaluate each head on each single trajectory, then average losses within example.
Run the one registered paired bootstrap, report result, costs and immutable artifact manifest.

confirmation.primary_estimand: Expected single-rollout BCE of the mean-feature-fitted head minus that of the risk-fitted head, averaged equally across the three frozen encoders.
confirmation.paired_observations: Both heads are evaluated on identical cached confirmation traces and labels. Average 32 losses within an example before inference; do not treat the 32 rollouts as independent examples.
confirmation.bootstrap: 4000 registered replicas: sample three encoder indices with replacement, then paired complete examples within each selected encoder. Preserve all within-example repeats.
confirmation.single_gate: Empirical lower endpoint exceeds 0.02 and all three encoder-specific means are positive.
confirmation.coverage_limit: An empirical resampling summary conditional on three already-selected frozen encoders; not a population coverage guarantee, new training-seed robustness result or universal superiority statement.
confirmation.descriptive_only: The original native head may be evaluated on the same fresh traces as a predeclared reference, with no additional gate or post-hoc selection.

claims.if_passed: For these three frozen order-task representations and this bounded fresh-data experiment, fitting the diagnostic head to single-rollout risk improved that risk relative to fitting to mean features by the proposed margin.
not_allowed: The original native network was repaired or original confirmation gates now pass.
The upstream straight-through estimator is unbiased or the encoder learned optimally.
The method beats LIF/RNN across tasks, is compute-optimal, or has optimal coupled-neuron firing boundaries.
claims.coverage_limit: An empirical resampling summary conditional on three already-selected frozen encoders; not a population coverage guarantee, new training-seed robustness result or universal superiority statement.
claims.native_head_warning: Jensen convexity explains why the two objectives differ but does not guarantee out-of-sample improvement after fitting. The native head already used a single-rollout BCE objective during joint training; this proposal therefore tests a diagnostic explanation, not a correction of the original native-head objective or upstream surrogate.

cost_accounting: Cache generation is shared by both arms; report its measured wall time/event counts separately from optimizer iterations and head fitting time. Deployed prediction uses one trajectory. Confirmation repeats estimate expected risk; they are not an ensemble policy.
stop_rule: Run the frozen design once. Report pass, negative result or numerical incompleteness with all six heads and all three encoders. Do not add repeats, choose a subset of encoders, lower the margin, switch to ensemble loss or start a width/optimizer sweep to obtain a pass. Any subsequent study is a distinct research question with fresh preregistration.

execution_guard.parent: Exactly one parent; equal CLI --freeze-commit and RUN_REQUEST.freeze_commit. The only parent-to-HEAD change must be addition of RUN_REQUEST.json; no source, workflow or result change is admitted.
execution_guard.ci_guard: Root-maintained CI must require pull_request.synchronize, exact subject and run_attempt=1; no later source-fix commit triggers execution. Script requires a wholly new output directory and has no resume/retry option.

output_contract.expected_streams: Every used input/trajectory key, full digest and decimal seed in per-shard streams.jsonl.gz; bootstrap stream separately.
output_contract.reproduction: Verify retained source freeze and the six-head pre-confirmation freeze. Read retained caches and heads only. Recompute the same descriptive losses and same4000 bootstrap replicas; do not run an encoder, generate new inputs or refit. Compare numeric output at rtol=atol=1e-12 and decisions exactly.
